title: perideridia rusbyi
intro: Perideridia rusbyi, commonly known as Rusby's Indian valerian or Rusby's valerian, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include alleviating anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness due to its calming effects. The health benefits of Perideriana rusbyi include reducing stress, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality, which can be attributed to its therapeutic actions as a sedative and anxiolytic agent. The bioactive constituents of Perideridia rusbyi include valerenic acid and other sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its sedative and anxiolytic properties.
